registry.description: Live object and trait names, source and any unused/shadowed definitions.

obligationScope.description: Current accepted catalog scope ruling, independent of historical row classification proposals and target capability evidence. Retained obligations are not implementation or maturity claims.

runtimeEvidence.description: Current validated packed-runtime ratio and recorded head, or an explicit unavailable reason; independent of component scope and approval.

components.description: Array of component catalog entries: brief entries by default for an unfiltered call, summary or full entries on request.

anyOf.description: A brief entry (detail brief, the unfiltered default).

totalCount.description: Total number of components that match the filters (before pagination).

returnedCount.description: Number of components returned in this page.

pageSize.description: Page size used for pagination. 0 when there are no results.

hasMore.description: Whether more components are available after this page.

detail.description: Detail level applied to component entries.

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when catalog was generated

filteredCount.description: Total components matching the active filters

availableCategories.description: All available category values that can be used for filtering. Sorted alphabetically.

suggestions.description: Suggested filter values when a query returns zero results.

targetPropTypes.description: Each prop by name: its TypeScript type as the declaration writes it, and whether it is optional.

componentReadiness.description: One label from the measured surfaces: proven-in-generated-apps = React and Vue implementations with evidence, placed in a generated app that passed the runtime gates; react-and-vue = implemented in both with evidence, not yet placed in a generated app; incomplete = a framework implementation or its evidence is missing. The evidence is productReality, in detail full.

tags.description: Component tags for search and discovery

contexts.description: Rendering contexts where component can be used

regions.description: UI regions where component can appear

productReality.description: Additive target-specific capability and evidence ledger. Use this instead of legacy status for React, Vue, generated-consumer, accessibility, theme, and interaction claims; row classifications/reconciliationState are historical proposals, subject to the current obligationScope ruling.

status.description: Legacy static-HTML renderer status only. 'stable' = has a mapped HTML renderer; 'planned' = the HTML renderer falls back. This is not a React, Vue, code-generation, or release-readiness claim.

maturity.description: Maturity indicator derived from the source trait (e.g., 'stable', 'beta', 'draft').

deprecated_since.description: DSL version since which this component is deprecated. When set, tools surface deprecation warnings in meta.warnings.

propSchema.description: Component prop schema with types and defaults (detail=full only). It describes the static HTML renderer (see propSchemaTarget); a React or Vue component's props are in propTypes.

propSchemaTarget.description: The target propSchema describes: the static HTML renderer, whose prop names can differ from the React and Vue components' (detail=full only).

propTypes.description: The React and Vue components' props, with their types, from the published declarations of @oods/components-react and @oods/components-vue (detail=full only).

slots.description: Slot definitions with accepted types and roles (detail=full only).

codeReferences.description: References into Storybook `.stories.tsx` files (usage patterns + minimal snippets, detail=full only).

path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path to a source file containing a usage example.

snippet.description: Concise usage snippet extracted from the story file.

codeSnippet.description: Convenience: best single snippet picked from codeReferences (detail=full only).

state.description: Evidence-derived state for this specific capability surface.

evidence.description: Repo-relative evidence references supporting the state.

reason.description: Explicit explanation for an unavailable, failed, or not-applicable capability surface.
